content.text: No Customer-side MFN exists anywhere; the only MFN-style term runs in our favour.

input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation on Client. The only MFN-style covenant (Section 6, p0047) runs in our favour: TrueLink undertakes that Hosting Services rates will not exceed those charged to any other party, together with a one-year price freeze. The compensation terms (p0045) simply require Client to pay TrueLink's scheduled fees and contain no obligation to extend to TrueLink terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers, and the licence provisions expressly leave Client free to use alternatives. This meets the preferred position (no Customer MFN obligation), so no redline is proposed; we would resist any later attempt to add a reciprocal MFN burdening Client.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
mappings.quote: rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party
